It writes only to /app: 'mkdir -p /app', 'cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/', then 'rm -f -- "$database_path" "$database_path-wal" "$database_path-shm"' where database_path is realpath of ${DB_PATH:-/app/app.db} and is refused unless under /app/*. No writes to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution; no pkill, NODE_ENV, npm install, pip or bare nproc (grep empty). The embedded node heredoc only reads /proc to refuse resetting a DB still held open; on a fresh /app no DB exists and it exits 0 before any scan (process.argv[2] verified locally to be the path argument for 'node - <path>'). No app.db is shipped in solution/app (tree listing). ENTRY/PORT/DB: server.js = "require('./src/index.js')"; index.js main thread calls bootstrap.start, which listens on Number(process.env.PORT || 3000) at 0.0.0.0 (bootstrap.js:43) and answers GET /api/health and /health with 200 before any DB work (bootstrap.js:20-23); the worker inherits process.env incl. DB_PATH (bootstrap.js:45). db.js:9 'const DB_PATH = process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(__dirname, '..', 'app.db')' = /app/app.db by default; mkdirSync(dirname) supports the test.sh /tmp/submission fallback (test.sh:97-102). Seeding idempotent: seedIfEmpty returns if users COUNT>0 and inserts in one transaction (db.js:61-85). Self-contained: seed read from src/seed_data.json beside the module (db.js:10), byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (cmp); no runtime read of /assets or /instructions, no child_process. Dependencies express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 match package.json and are preinstalled globally in BOTH environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, which test.sh passes to the env -i launch (test.sh:104-111); no node_modules or symlinks shipped, so test.sh's symlink refusal (72-83) is not triggered. Contract matches instruction.md line 13-15 and integration.md. RUNTIME (raw-evidence-index hashes re-verified; all 12 matching_source_files hashes equal the frozen task bytes): workspace.cjs launch() spawns 'node /app/server.js' with a minimal env {PATH,HOME,NODE_PATH,PORT=3000,DB_PATH=/tmp/hireops-workspace.db}, reported as uid 65534 in the verifier image; server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice (initial + restart); workspace.json records 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages and activity without reseeding; live updates resume' passed:true and page_errors [].
